[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS

Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies

Nature of Operations

Google was incorporated in California in September 1998 and re-incorporated in the State of Delaware in August 2003. In 2015, we implemented a holding company reorganization, and as a result, Alphabet Inc. ("Alphabet") became the successor issuer to Google. We generate revenues by delivering relevant, cost-effective online advertising; cloud-based solutions that provide enterprise customers of all sizes with infrastructure, platform services, and applications; and sales of other products and services, such as fees received for subscription-based products, apps and in-app purchases, and devices. Basis of Consolidation

The consolidated financial statements of Alphabet include the accounts of Alphabet and entities consolidated under the variable interest and voting models. Intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated. Use of Estimates

Preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires us to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported and disclosed in the financial statements and the accompanying notes. Actual results could differ materially from these estimates due to uncertainties. On an ongoing basis, we evaluate our estimates, including those related to the allowance for credit losses; contingent liabilities; fair values of financial instruments and goodwill; income taxes; inventory; and useful lives of property and equipment, among others. We base our estimates on assumptions, both historical and forward looking, that are believed to be reasonable, and the results of which form the basis for making judgments about the carrying values of assets and liabilities. Revenue Recognition

Revenues are recognized when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to our customers, and the collectibility of an amount that we expect in exchange for those goods or services is probable. Sales and other similar taxes are excluded from revenues. Google Advertising

Google advertising revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Search and other properties, including revenues from traffic generated by search distribution partners who use Google.com as their default search in browsers, toolbars, etc. and other Google owned and operated properties like Gmail, Google Maps, and Google Play;

•YouTube properties; and

•Google Network properties, including revenues from Google Network properties participating in AdMob, AdSense, and Google Ad Manager. Our customers generally purchase advertising inventory through Google Ads, Google Ad Manager, Google Display & Video 360, and Google Marketing Platform, among others. We offer advertising by delivering both performance and brand advertising. We recognize revenues for performance advertising when a user engages with the advertisement. For brand advertising, we recognize revenues when the ad is displayed, or a user views the ad. For ads placed on Google Network properties, we evaluate whether we are the principal (i.e., report revenues on a gross basis) or agent (i.e., report revenues on a net basis). Generally, we report advertising revenues for ads placed on Google Network properties on a gross basis, that is, the amounts billed to our customers are recorded as revenues, and amounts paid to Google Network partners are recorded as cost of revenues. Where we are the principal, we control the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers. Our control is evidenced by our sole ability to monetize the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers and is further supported by us being primarily responsible to our customers and having a level of discretion in establishing pricing. Google Subscriptions, Platforms, and Devices

Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices revenues consist of revenues from:

53. Alphabet Inc. •consumer subscriptions, which primarily include revenues from YouTube services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, and NFL Sunday Ticket, as well as Google One, which offers access to our most capable Gemini models;

•platforms, which primarily include revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases;

•devices, which primarily include sales of the Pixel family of devices; and

•other products and services. Subscription revenues are recognized ratably over the period of the subscription, primarily monthly. We report revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases on a net basis because our performance obligation is to facilitate a transaction between app developers and end users for which we earn a service fee. Google Cloud

Google Cloud revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Cloud Platform primarily generates consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, and other services. These services provide access to solutions such as AI offerings including our enterprise AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini Enterprise; cybersecurity offerings; and data and analytics solutions;

•Google Workspace includes subscriptions for cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Gmail, Docs, Calendar, Drive, and Meet, with integrated features like Gemini for Google Workspace; and

•other enterprise services. Our cloud services are generally provided on either a consumption or subscription basis and may have contract terms longer than a year.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We strive to execute long-term supply contracts for such materials at competitive pricing when feasible, and actively manage supply of raw materials to meet the needs of our operations. We continue to localize and de-risk our supply chains across regions, including through vertical integration where possible, such as our in-house lithium refinery in Texas, which began operations in January 2026. Governmental Programs, Incentives and Regulations

Globally, the ownership of our products by our customers is impacted by various government credits, incentives, and policies.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] In order to enable a greater supply of cells for our products with higher energy density at lower costs, we have developed a new proprietary lithium-ion battery cell and improved manufacturing processes. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. By taking a modular approach to the design of battery systems, we can optimize manufacturing capacity of our energy storage products. Additionally, our expertise in power electronics enables our battery systems to interconnect with electricity grids while providing fast-acting systems for power injection and absorption. We have also developed software to remotely control and dispatch our energy storage systems. Further leveraging our capabilities in AI, every Tesla energy storage product is capable of being enhanced through firmware updates and optimized by our software platforms, particularly Powerhub (for distributed energy resources, including Powerwall-enabled virtual power plants) and Autobidder (for Megapack batteries). Energy Generation Systems

We began manufacturing a new residential retrofit solar panel in 2025, and began initial customer deliveries in January 2026. We continue to manufacture Solar Roof, which has been engineered over numerous iterations to combine aesthetic appeal and durability with power generation. The efficiency of our energy generation products is aided by our own solar inverter, which incorporates our power electronics technologies. We designed both products to integrate with Powerwall. Infrastructure

To support our businesses in clean energy and transport and autonomous robots, we are investing in and developing the necessary supporting infrastructure. This includes additional compute hardware to better enable the massive amounts of field data captured by our vehicles to continually train and improve these artificial neural networks for real-world performance. In 2025, we further expanded Cortex, our training cluster at Gigafactory Texas, and announced a new collaboration with Samsung to manufacture advanced semiconductors for AI inference and training in the U.S. We are currently building Cortex 2 at Gigafactory Texas to further increase our AI training compute capacity. In 2026, we will be ramping six new production lines across vehicle, Bots, energy storage and battery manufacturing, while further leveraging our existing factory, charging and service center footprints to support future growth.

records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
大家做 AI 都離不開 NVIDIA 的技術，核心原因是 NVIDIA 不只是賣晶片，而是打造了一套從硬體、網路到軟體的「全端加速運算平台」，加上十幾年累積的龐大開發者生態系，讓競爭對手難以複製。

以下是具體原因：

**1. 全端資料中心級協同設計**

NVIDIA 的優勢不在單一晶片，而在於將晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法進行整體架構與最佳化，讓數十萬顆 GPU 能互連成一台巨型電腦，這種資料中心規模的架構是現代 AI 開發與部署所必需的 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。其運算方案涵蓋 AI 伺服器中的三大處理器——GPU、CPU 與 DPU，加上互連技術、交換晶片與系統，構成完整的資料中心規模運算方案 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**2. CUDA 軟體生態壁壘**

NVIDIA 自 2006 年推出 CUDA 開發平台，將 GPU 的平行運算能力開放給各種運算密集應用，為現代 AI 鋪路 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。目前全球有超過 750 萬名開發者使用 CUDA 及其他軟體工具 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。龐大且持續成長的開發者基礎與安裝量強化了 NVIDIA 的生態系，提升了平台對客戶的價值 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。此外，NVIDIA 超過一半的工程師投入軟體開發，建立了數百個特定領域的軟體庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

**3. 持續的架構創新與產品節奏**

NVIDIA 以強烈的工程文化驅動快速且協調的產品與技術創新 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。在 fiscal year 2025 推出 Blackwell 架構，連接 36 顆 Grace CPU 與 72 顆 Blackwell GPU，實現資料中心規模的液冷設計，用於即時兆級參數推論與訓練 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25]。在 fiscal year 2026，NVIDIA 推出並擴大部署 Blackwell Ultra 平台，相較 Hopper 世代，在 token 吞吐量上顯著提升並降低每 token 成本 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。NVIDIA 也公布了 Rubin 平台，預計於 fiscal year 2027 下半年開始量產出貨，相較 Blackwell 可將每 token 成本降低至多 10 倍 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25]。

**4. 企業級 AI 軟體方案**

NVIDIA 提供 NVIDIA AI Enterprise，這是一套完整的企業級 AI 軟體套件，包含 NVIDIA NIM（提升 token 吞吐量）、NVIDIA NeMo（用於策展、微調、強化學習與評估模型）以及 AI Blueprints（預建可執行範本，協助企業建置與部署 AI 代理）[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。這些工具讓企業能在 NVIDIA 加速基礎設施上安全地開發與運行 AI 應用 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**5. 策略合作夥伴與生態普及度**

NVIDIA 的運算平台幾乎可從所有主要伺服器製造商與雲端服務提供商（CSP）取得，同時也在 NVIDIA 自有的 AI 超級電腦上提供 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。所有主要 CSP、AI 模型製造商與企業都使用 NVIDIA 的資料中心規模基礎設施與運算平台 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。NVIDIA 也透過與數百所大學及數萬家新創公司的 Inception 計畫合作推廣 AI [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**6. 統一架構支援多元市場**

NVIDIA 採用平台策略，以統一的可程式架構支援多個數十億美元規模的終端市場，包括資料中心 AI、遊戲、專業視覺化與自動駕駛等，透過內部或第三方開發的各種軟體堆疊來滿足不同運算需求 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。自成立以來，NVIDIA 已投入超過 767 億美元於研發 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟主要是透過一個名為 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 的 AI 工具，將人工智慧能力直接嵌入 Office 系列產品中，讓企業與個人用戶能在通訊、協作與分析等場景使用 AI 功能 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

以下是微軟將 AI 整合進軟體的具體做法與涵蓋層面：

**1. 產品層面：Microsoft 365 Copilot 與核心應用整合**
微軟將 Microsoft 365 Copilot 納入其「Microsoft 365 Commercial」雲端服務的組成項目中，該雲端服務還包含 Exchange、SharePoint、Microsoft Teams 以及 Power BI 等核心辦公軟體 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。微軟將 Microsoft 365 Commercial 定位為一個「AI-powered business and productivity solutions platform」（AI 驅動的商業與生產力解決方案平台），將 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 與企業行動力與安全性整合在一起，協助組織賦能員工 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**2. 功能與場景擴展：加入 AI 工具與代理情境**
在產品策略上，微軟的成長取決於其能否將「AI-enabled tools, features, and agentic scenarios」（AI 啟用的工具、功能與代理情境）加入其核心產品與服務中，涵蓋範圍包括通訊、協作、分析、安全性、合規性以及其他 AI 商業生產力類別 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。同樣地，在消費端產品（Microsoft 365 Consumer）中，微軟也透過加入包含 AI 工具在內的新功能來為核心產品增加價值 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**3. 企業與商業應用：Dynamics 365 的代理 AI**
除了 Office 軟體外，微軟也將 AI 應用於商業解決方案中。其 Dynamics 產品線提供了「agentic AI」（代理 AI）以及低程式碼應用程式開發平台，服務中小型企業與大型組織 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**4. 底層技術與外部合作：與 OpenAI 的策略聯盟**
微軟與 OpenAI 建立了長期的策略合作夥伴關係，並在 October 2025 and April 2026, we extended this partnership [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #99]。微軟是 OpenAI 的主要投資者，並持有 OpenAI 智慧財產權（包含模型與基礎設施）的權利，可將其整合到微軟自家的產品中 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #99]。此外，微軟的 Azure and other cloud services 也包含了雲端與 AI 的消耗型服務（consumption-based services），為這些 AI 功能提供底層的運算與基礎設施支援 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #101]。

**5. 基礎設施投資與風險**
為了支撐這些 AI 服務的成長需求，微軟持續投資雲端與 AI 基礎設施，並評估擴展資料中心位置與增加伺服器容量 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #99]。然而，這些在雲端與 AI 基礎設施上的投資將持續增加營運成本，可能會降低營運利潤率 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #99]。資料中心的營運也高度依賴可用土地、穩定能源、網路供應以及包含圖形處理器（GPU）在內的伺服器元件 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #99]。

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜在 AI 領域最明確的投資動作是透過可轉換公司債向 AI 新創公司 Anthropic 注入大量資金，同時在 AWS 基礎設施上進行了大規模的資本擴張。

**與 Anthropic 的投資關係**
亞馬遜的投資組合中持有 Anthropic 的可轉換票據。根據 2025 年第三季度的財報揭露，亞馬遜在 2025 年第二季額外投資了 13 億美元於 Anthropic 的可轉換票據，並計畫在 2025 年第四季再投資 14 億美元於另一筆可轉換票據 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #63]。

**AWS 基礎設施與資本支出的大規模擴張**
為了支撐包含 AI 運算在內的技術服務，亞馬遜將技術基礎設施資產主要分配給 AWS 部門，並持續擴大固定資產的淨增加額。在 2025 年前三季（截至 9 月 30 日的九個月），AWS 部門的固定資產淨增加額為 648.08 億美元，延續了 2024 年同期 350.23 億美元的成長趨勢 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #56]。此外，AWS 部門的總資產規模也從 2024 年底的 1,559.53 億美元，成長至 2025 年 9 月 30 日的 2,237.29 億美元 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #56]。

**透過併購獲取 AI 技術**
在企業併購方面，亞馬遜在 2025 年完成了數筆以獲取技術與專業知識為主要目的的交易，旨在更有效地服務客戶並擴大客戶基礎，儘管這些交易的金額對合併營運結果並不重大 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #84]。

records.query: Google 的 AI 助手現在有整合進搜尋引擎裡嗎？
records.answer:
是的，Google 已將其 AI 模型 Gemini 整合進搜尋引擎中，讓使用者能用更自然的語言提問並獲得 AI 生成的回覆。

具體而言，Google 搜尋已推出 **AI Overviews** 功能，讓使用者更容易向 Google 提問並獲得有用的回應 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。此外還有 **AI Mode**，允許使用者提出過去可能需要多次搜尋才能解答的更細緻問題，此功能運用了 Gemini 的先進推理、思考及多模態能力 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

大型語言模型使得更自然的語言查詢成為可能，大幅改善了使用者能提出的問題類型及結果品質 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。Google 的 **Gemini 3** 模型具備先進的多模態理解能力，整合了增強的推理能力以支援跨產品生態系的視覺化與互動使用者體驗，包括搜尋和 Gemini 應用程式 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。目前 Google 所有 15 個擁有五億使用者的產品（其中 7 個擁有二十億使用者）都在使用 Gemini 模型 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

Revenue Recognition

records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 的 VR 眼鏡與 AI 發展方向是打造「下一代運算平台」——以 AI 驅動的沉浸式體驗（包括 AR/VR 眼鏡與穿戴裝置）取代傳統二維螢幕，並推進 AI 模型以實現超越人類智慧的「超級智慧」[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

以下是具體發展方向：

**一、AI 發展方向**

Meta 正在創新 AI 技術，在其 Family of Apps 與新平台上建立變革性體驗與能力，並推進其打造超級智慧（superintelligence）的目標，Meta 將其定義為超越人類智慧的 AI [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Meta 的 AI 投資支援其產品與服務中的多項倡議，包括為應用程式中的內容排序、推薦相關內容的探索引擎、廣告主觸及客戶的工具、新的生成式 AI 體驗，以及提升產品開發效率與生產力的工具 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Meta 也在開發下一代 AI 模型，並推進其打造超級智慧的目標 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Meta 預期將持續增加用於開發與訓練其 AI 模型的投資 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。此外，Meta AI 是一個可跨應用程式、作為獨立應用程式、在 AI 眼鏡上及網路上使用的助理，旨在協助人們學習、完成事務、創作內容並與他人連結 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**二、VR 眼鏡與穿戴裝置發展方向**

Meta 的 Reality Labs（RL）致力於開發虛擬與擴增實境裝置、社交平台軟體、神經介面及其他基礎技術，這些是 Meta 認為將發展為下一代運算平台的新技術 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。具體產品包括：

- **VR 方面**：Meta 推出 Meta Quest 裝置，以及透過 Meta Horizon Store 提供的軟體與內容，提供遊戲、健身、娛樂等社交體驗，並引入透視（passthrough）功能，讓使用者在體驗 VR 沉浸感的同時仍能與物理世界保持連結 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

- **穿戴裝置方面**：包括 AI 眼鏡與長期 AR 倡議。目前的 AI 眼鏡包括 Ray-Ban Meta 和 Oakley Meta 眼鏡，配備 Meta AI 對話助理與免持互動等功能 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。2024 年 Meta 展示了 Orion 原型，這是一副能在眼鏡形態下將內容疊加於物理世界之上的真正 AR 眼鏡 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。2025 年，Meta 推出了 Meta Ray-Ban Display，將 AI 眼鏡與內建於鏡片中的顯示器結合，並搭配 Meta Neural Band——一種使用肌電圖讓使用者透過神經肌肉訊號控制 AI 眼鏡的腕戴式裝置 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]。

**三、2026 年投資重點分配**

在 2026 年，Meta 預計將約 70% 的 Reality Labs 營運支出投入穿戴裝置倡議，剩餘 30% 投入 VR 與 Horizon 倡議 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。2025 年，Meta 的 RL 總投資為 214 億美元，而 FoA（Family of Apps）投資為 962.9 億美元，佔總成本與費用的 82% [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。

**四、財務影響與風險**

Meta 的 Reality Labs 投資在 2025 年使其整體營業利潤減少約 191.9 億美元，且 Meta 預期 2026 年 Reality Labs 的營業虧損將與 2025 年持平 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。Meta 預期 RL 部門在可預見的未來將持續虧損，其支持這些努力的能力取決於從其他業務領域產生足夠利潤 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。這些技術是根本性的新技術，許多產品可能要到下一個十年才能完全實現 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。

[META 10-K period 2025] We invest in our business based on our company priorities. In 2026, we intend to focus on several key investment areas: AI, Reels and our discovery engine, wearables, monetization of our products and services, youth, platform integrity and community support, and infrastructure capacity. The majority of our investments are directed toward developing our family of apps. In 2025, 82% of our total costs and expenses were recognized in FoA and 18% were recognized in RL. records.query: 特斯拉的自動駕駛跟別家車廠比，厲害在哪裡？
records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛技術與其他車廠相比，主要差異化優勢在於：採用視覺基礎技術訓練類神經網路、使用自家設計的推論晶片加速運算、透過OTA軟體更新持續改善車輛功能，以及將AI能力延伸至機器人領域 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

以下逐項說明特斯拉的差異化優勢：

**1. 視覺基礎技術與自研晶片**
特斯拉利用視覺基礎技術、系統與軟體來訓練其人工類神經網路，這些網路由其自家內部設計的客製化推論晶片加速運算 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**2. OTA軟體更新**
特斯拉透過OTA（over-the-air）軟體更新來改善其客戶車輛中的各項功能，並在每次發布時積極提升軟體安全性 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**3. 車輛設計與AI差異化**
每一輛今日交付的特斯拉車輛在設計時皆為自主而設計（"designed for autonomy"），特斯拉相信其在AI方面的能力與進展使其與競爭對手產生差異 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**4. Robotaxi服務**
2025年6月，特斯拉推出了Robotaxi服務，這是一個自主叫車平台，結合了其技術與車輛 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。該Robotaxi業務目前以Model Y車輛運營，但未來將納入Cybercab，即特斯拉專為自主駕駛打造的車輛（"our purpose-built autonomous vehicle"）[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**5. AI技術延伸至機器人**
特斯拉也將其從自動駕駛技術中獲得的人工智慧學習應用於Bots，例如Optimus，一款正在開發中的通用自主人形機器人（"a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development"）[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**6. NVIDIA作為對照**
作為對照，NVIDIA為自動駕駛車輛與電動車市場提供名為DRIVE品牌的AI硬體與軟體解方案，並透過與汽車OEM、行動服務提供商、無人計程車（robotaxis）、一級供應商及新創公司的合作夥伴關係將其推向市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #29]。NVIDIA的AV解決方案還包含基於GPU的硬體，用於在車輛部署前訓練類神經網路，以及在OTA軟體更新前重新模擬其運作 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #29]。這顯示特斯拉與NVIDIA在自動駕駛領域的策略不同：特斯拉強調自研晶片與視覺基礎技術的端到端整合 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]，而NVIDIA則定位為提供AI硬體與軟體平台予產業合作夥伴 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #29]。

**注意事項**：目前特斯拉提供的仍為先進駕駛輔助系統，駕駛人仍須保持完全投入駕駛操作（"the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation"）[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

We receive upfront payment for the vehicle, do not bear casualty and credit risks during the lease term, and we provide a guarantee capped to a limit if they are unable to sell the vehicle at or above the vehicle’s contractual or determined residual value at the end of the lease term. We estimate a guarantee liability in accordance with ASC 460, Guarantees and record it within other liabilities on our consolidated balance sheets. On a quarterly basis, we assess the estimated market value of vehicles sold under these programs to determine whether there have been changes to the amount of expected resale value guarantee liabilities. Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. The automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacturing, sales and leasing of high-performance fully electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes sales, leasing, and financing of energy generation and storage products, services related to such products and sales of energy generation incentives. Our Products and Services

Automotive

We currently manufacture five different consumer vehicles – the Model 3, Y, S, X and Cybertruck. Model 3 is a four-door mid-size sedan that we designed for manufacturability with a base price for mass-market appeal. Model Y is a compact sport utility vehicle (“SUV”) built on the Model 3 platform with seating for up to seven adults. Model S is a four-door full-size sedan and Model X is a mid-size SUV with seating for up to seven adults. Model S and Model X feature the highest performance characteristics and longest ranges that we offer in a sedan and SUV, respectively. The Cybertruck is a full-size electric pickup truck with a stainless steel exterior that has the utility and strength of a truck while featuring the speed of a sports car. In 2022, we also began early production and deliveries of a commercial electric vehicle, the Tesla Semi.

Regulation of Autonomous Vehicles and Autonomous Vehicle Ride-Hailing 

Generally, laws pertaining to autonomous vehicles are evolving globally, and in some cases may impose restrictions on our features or vehicle designs. In the U.S., while NHTSA has updated certain FMVSS to account for autonomous vehicle design, other FMVSS and regulations do not currently account for autonomous vehicle design and additional rulemaking by NHTSA may occur. Additionally, certain U.S. states and cities have legal restrictions on, or are considering additional regulation of, the testing, commercial operation, marketing, registration and licensure of autonomous vehicles, including commercial ride-hailing with a fleet of autonomous vehicles, and many other states and cities are considering them. This regulatory patchwork increases the legal complexity with respect to autonomous vehicles and an autonomous vehicle ride-hailing business in the U.S. In Europe and other countries that follow the regulations of the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (“ECE countries”), some requirements restrict the design of both advanced driver-assistance and autonomous systems, which can compromise or prevent their use entirely. When coupled together, the layers of regulation as well as the fragmentation across each ECE country may hinder or complicate the path and timeline to introducing autonomous vehicles and an autonomous vehicle ride-hailing business in them. Other key markets, including China, continue to develop and establish driver-assistance and autonomous vehicle regulations. Any implemented regulations may differ materially from U.S.

In addition, certain government and economic incentives which provide benefits to manufacturers who assemble domestically or have local suppliers, may provide a greater benefit to our competitors, which could negatively impact our profitability. Many of our competitors have significantly more or better-established resources than we do to devote to the design, development, manufacturing, distribution, promotion, sale and support of their products and services, and may achieve additional cost efficiencies owing to location and economic environments. Increased competition could result in our lower vehicle unit sales, price reductions, revenue shortfalls, loss of customers and loss of market share, which may harm our business, financial condition and operating results. We also face competition in our energy generation and storage business from other manufacturers, developers, installers and service providers of competing energy technologies, as well as from large utilities. In addition, decreases in the retail or wholesale prices of electricity from utilities or other renewable energy sources could make our products less attractive to customers and lead to an increased rate of customer defaults. Growth of our business is also dependent upon our ability to develop and commercialize Bots, including Optimus, which is in a nascent industry that has yet to develop commercially. 15


We currently are developing Bots, including Optimus, and intend for these products, as well as accompanying services, to be an important part of our business going forward. We also face significant competition from other companies that are designing, developing and building robotics applications. Our success will depend on various factors, including our ability to successfully apply our artificial neural network training experience to autonomous robots, to either source or custom develop the necessary technology and components, and the product’s cost-effectiveness, utility and competitive positioning relative to market alternatives. If our Bots program fails to develop as we expect, or progresses more slowly than expected, our business, prospects, financial condition and operating results may be harmed. Risks Related to Our Operations

[NVDA 10-K period 2026] We believe the advent of autonomous vehicles, or AV, and electric vehicles, or EV, is revolutionizing the transportation industry. The algorithms required for autonomous driving - such as reasoning, perception, localization, and planning - are too complex for legacy hand-coded approaches and will use multiple neural networks instead. Therefore, we provide an AI-based hardware and software solution, designed and implemented from the ground up based on automotive safety standards, for the AV and EV market under the DRIVE brand, which we are bringing to market through our partnerships across the transportation industry including with automotive OEMs, mobility service providers, robotaxis, tier-1 suppliers, and start-ups. Our AV solution also includes the GPU-based hardware required to train the neural networks before their in-vehicle deployment, as well as to re-simulate their operation prior to any over-the-air software updates. We believe our comprehensive, top-to-bottom and end-to-end approach will enable the transportation industry to solve the complex problems arising from the shift to autonomous driving. 7

Engineering and marketing personnel engage with key software developers to promote and discuss our platforms, as well as to ascertain individual product requirements and solve technical problems. Our developer program supports the development of AI frameworks, SDKs, and APIs for software applications and game titles that are optimized for our platforms. records.query: 蘋果自己是不是也承認在手機市場其實不算市佔龍頭？
records.answer:
根據提供的參考資料，蘋果的財務報告中並未提及任何關於手機市場整體市佔率或是否為市佔龍頭的討論。

不過，資料中確實揭露了 iPhone 在蘋果自身營收結構中的佔比，可供參考：

- 在 2026 會計年度第二季（截至 2026 年 3 月 28 日的三個月），iPhone 淨銷售額為 $56,994 百萬美元，佔總淨銷售額 $111,184 百萬美元的約 51.3% [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #19]。
- 在 2025 會計年度（截至 2025 年 9 月 27 日），iPhone 淨銷售額為 $209,586 百萬美元，佔當年總淨銷售額 $416,161 百萬美元的約 50.4% [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #42]。

這些數字僅反映 iPhone 對蘋果自身營收的貢獻比例，並不涉及蘋果在全球或區域手機市場的市佔率排名，也沒有蘋果是否承認非市佔龍頭的相關陳述。

需要注意的是，來源資料中直接標示的「自由現金流」數字為 370.01 億美元 [MSFT_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1]，而現金流量表本身並未使用「自由現金流」一詞，也未提供將營運現金流減去資本支出後的計算結果。因此，若要得出年度可自由運用現金的具體數字，應以基本面資料中的 370.01 億美元為準；現金流量表中的營運現金流與資本支出數據則可作為理解其現金產生與使用結構的參考。

records.query: 微軟的雲端服務最近成長得快不快？
records.answer:
微軟的雲端服務近期成長相當快速，其中 Azure 及其他雲端服務在最近一季營收成長了 39%，是成長最突出的項目。以下依各項雲端相關業務逐一說明：

**Azure 及其他雲端服務**
- 最近一季（MSFT 10-Q period 202512）營收成長 39%，主要受服務組合需求帶動，各項工作負載持續成長 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- 全年度（MSFT 10-K period 2025）營收成長 34%，同樣受服務組合需求帶動 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。

**Microsoft 365 商業版雲端（Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud）**
- 最近一季營收成長 17%，每位使用者營收成長受 Microsoft 365 E5 及 Microsoft 365 Copilot 帶動；商業版座位數（seats）成長 6%，主要受中小企業與前線員工方案帶動 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- 全年度營收成長 15%，商業版座位數成長 6%，每位使用者營收亦有所成長 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。

**Dynamics 365**
- 最近一季營收成長 19%，各項工作負載均有成長 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- 全年度營收成長 19%，各項工作負載均有成長 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。

**LinkedIn**
- 最近一季營收成長 11%，受 Marketing Solutions 成長帶動 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- 全年度營收成長 9%，各業務線均有成長 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。

**Microsoft 365 Consumer 相關指標（屬 Productivity and Business Processes 部門）**
- 最近一季，Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue 成長 29%，受每位使用者營收成長及 Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriber 成長 6% 帶動 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。
- 全年度，Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue 成長 11%，受 Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriber 成長 8% 至 89.0 百萬以及每位使用者營收成長帶動 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。

**整體部門層級**
- Intelligent Cloud 部門最近一季營收增加 74 億美元，成長 29% [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]；全年度營收增加 188 億美元，成長 21% [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。
- Productivity and Business Processes 部門最近一季營收成長 22%（營業利益增加 37 億美元）[MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]；全年度營收增加 140 億美元，成長 13% [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。

**毛利率與 AI 基礎設施影響**
- 全年度 Microsoft Cloud 毛利率百分比下降至 69%，主因為擴充 AI 基礎設施的影響，部分被 Azure 的效率提升所抵銷 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。
- 最近一季毛利率百分比上升，主要受 Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 效率提升帶動，儘管持續投資 AI 基礎設施且 AI 產品使用量持續成長 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #107]。

records.query: Meta 最近這一季賺（營收）成長多少？
records.answer:
Meta 最近一季（2025 年第三季）的總營收為 $51.24 billion，較 2024 年第三季成長 26% [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。

若以固定匯率計算，營收年增率為 25% [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。匯率變動對第三季營收產生了有利影響，若使用前一年匯率換算，總營收將為 $50.83 billion，較實際營收低 $412 million [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #218]。

就各業務區塊而言，Family of Apps（FoA）第三季營收為 $50,772 million，年增 26% [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203]。Reality Labs（RL）第三季營收為 $470 million，年增 74%，主要受 Meta Quest 與 AI 眼鏡銷售增加帶動 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #203][META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #218]。

按地理區域劃分，2025 年第三季營收年增率分別為：美國與加拿大 24%、歐洲 29%、亞太地區 25%、其他地區 32% [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #211]。

records.query: 蘋果在大中華區最近賣得好不好？
records.answer:
蘋果在大中華區最近的銷售表現非常強勁，各季度均錄得顯著的同比增長，扭轉了此前下滑的趨勢。

**近期的強勁增長（2026 會計年度）**

在 2026 會計年度第二季（截至 2026 年 3 月 28 日的三個月），大中華區淨銷售額達到 204.97 億美元，較 2025 會計年度同期的 160.02 億美元增長了 28% [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65]。蘋果最近發布了有史以來最好的三月季度業績，總營收達 1112 億美元（增長 17%），其中大中華區增長了 28% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #2]。

在 2026 會計年度第一季（截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日的三個月），大中華區淨銷售額達到 255.26 億美元，較 2024 會計年度同期的 185.13 億美元增長了 38% [AAPL_10Q_202512.html, chunk #53]。

**增長驅動因素**

這兩個季度大中華區的增長主要歸因於 iPhone 銷售額的提高 [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65] [AAPL_10Q_202512.html, chunk #53]。此外，人民幣相對於美元的走強對大中華區淨銷售額產生了有利的同比影響 [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65]。報導指出，大中華區出現了急劇的反彈，人民幣的走強更是起到了推波助瀾的作用 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]。執行長 Tim Cook 稱對 iPhone 17 系列的需求「非凡」 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]。

**對比：此前曾出現下滑（2025 會計年度）**

相比之下，在 2025 會計年度（截至 2025 年 9 月的年度），大中華區淨銷售額為 643.77 億美元，較 2024 會計年度的 669.52 億美元下降了 4%，主要原因是 iPhone 銷售額下降，但部分被 Mac 銷售額的增加所抵消 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。這表明大中華區的銷售在最近幾個季度實現了明顯的由負轉正。

So is the run sustainable, or did Apple just front-load demand ahead of more tariff drama? Apple’s Business
Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)

iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. 以下是這項合作的具體細節：

**1. 策略合作與投資權**
IREN 與 NVIDIA 達成了一項 5 GW（吉瓦）的策略合作夥伴關係，聚焦於部署 NVIDIA DSX AI 工廠基礎設施，未來部署將以 IREN 位於德州 Sweetwater 的園區為中心 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。作為協議的一部分，IREN 向 NVIDIA 發行了為期五年的認股權，允許 NVIDIA 以每股 $70 的價格購買最多 3,000 萬股普通股；若全數行使，這項潛在投資規模最高可達 $21 億美元 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。NVIDIA 的投資權利會隨著 GPU 基礎設施在 IREN 園區的部署進度逐步歸屬，且只有在部署達 60 萬顆 GPU 時才會全數歸屬 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。

**2. AI Cloud 服務合約**
兩家公司另簽訂了一筆為期五年、價值 $34 億美元的 AI Cloud 合約，NVIDIA 將提供氣冷式 Blackwell GPU，部署範圍涵蓋 IREN 位於 Childress 的現有數據中心（合約提及部署於 60 MW 的範圍內），預計自 2027 年初開始放量 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。這筆合約的營收會隨著 GPU 逐步部署而歸屬 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。

**3. IREN 的業務轉型**
IREN 正將其業務從純比特幣挖礦轉向 AI 雲端服務 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]。在最近一季（Q3），IREN 的 AI Cloud 營收增至 $3,360 萬，而比特幣營收則降至 $1.112 億 [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。該公司已將合約年經常性收入（ARR）提升至 $31 億，並重申目標在 2026 年底達到 $37 億的 ARR [NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]。IREN 共同執行長 Daniel Roberts 表示，世界在算力上「結構性短缺」，瓶頸在於已交付的數據中心與 GPU 產能，而 IREN 正利用其電力資源與開發管線來滿足 AI 客戶需求 [NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #1]。

records.answer:
是的，特斯拉近期確實因為馬斯克另一家公司 SpaceX 即將上市，在市場關注度上退居次要位置，而特斯拉最新一季（2026 年第一季）營收年增約 15.8%、淨利年增約 16.9%，表現有所成長。

**SpaceX 上市搶走風頭：**
SpaceX 預計於 2026 年 6 月 12 日（週五）在 Nasdaq 掛牌上市，股票代號為 SPCX，目標 IPO 价格為每股 135 美元 [TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。到了 2026 年 7 月 20 日的特斯拉財報討論中，Yahoo Finance 的評論人士明確指出「特斯拉 kind of taken a back seat with all the hype on SpaceX right now」（特斯拉在 SpaceX 的熱潮中退居次要位置），並表示「不需要太多就能帶來看漲驚喜」，因為「股票最近沒有做什麼太令人興奮的事」 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。此外，評論中也提到馬斯克「下一件大事是合併」，雖然尚未正式確認，但已經被公開討論多年 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**2026 年第一季財務表現：**
- **營收**：Q1 2026 營收為 223.87 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 193.35 億美元成長 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0]。
- **淨利**：Q1 2026 淨利為 4.91 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 4.20 億美元成長 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0]。
- **營業利益**：Q1 2026 為 9.41 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 3.99 億美元大幅成長 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0]。
- **毛利率**：Q1 2026 毛利為 47.20 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 31.53 億美元成長 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0]。
- **每股盈餘**：Q1 2026 稀釋每股盈餘為 0.13 美元，較 2025 年同期的 0.12 美元略有成長 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0]。

**各業務板塊表現：**
- **汽車業務**：Q1 2026 營收 162.34 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 139.67 億美元成長 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0]。
- **能源發電與儲存**：Q1 2026 營收 24.08 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 27.30 億美元下滑 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0]。
- **服務及其他**：Q1 2026 營收 37.45 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 26.38 億美元顯著成長 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0]。

**現金流與資產負債：**
- Q1 2026 營運活動產生的現金淨額為 39.37 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 21.56 億美元大幅增加 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #2]。
- 投資活動中使用現金 50.23 億美元，其中包含 20.02 億美元購買 SpaceX 股權投資 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #2]。
- 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，現金及約當現金為 166.03 億美元，短期投資為 281.40 億美元 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #1]。

records.query: Apple 目前的獲利能力數字（毛利率、淨利率）為何？加上新聞中 Evercore ISI 最新調升的目標價與評等，市場如何綜合看待這家公司？
records.answer:
Apple 目前處於獲利能力的高峰：TTM（過去十二個月）毛利率達 47.9%，營業利益率 32.6%，而 Evercore ISI 將目標價從 330 美元調升至 365 美元並維持「優於大盤」評等，顯示市場在肯定其現金流與 Services 增長的同時，也關注其估值偏高的風險。

以下為詳細數據與市場觀點：

**一、獲利能力數字**

- **毛利率**：Apple 的 TTM 毛利率達到 47.9%，高於 FY 2024 的 46.2% 以及 FY 2019 的 38.2%，此增長主要受 Services 營收佔比上升所帶動 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。就 FY 2025 全年而言，總毛利率為 46.9%，其中 Products 毛利率為 36.8%，Services 毛利率為 75.4% [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。在 FY 2026 第一季度（截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日的三個月），總毛利率進一步提升至 48.2%，Products 毛利率升至 40.7%，Services 毛利率升至 76.5% [AAPL_10Q_202512.html, chunk #54]。

- **營業利益率與淨利率**：Apple 的 TTM 營業利益率目前為 32.6% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。在淨利方面，FY 2025 全年淨利為 1,120.1 億美元 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #42]；以 TTM 為基礎計算，Apple 從營運中產生了 1,402 億美元的現金，槓桿自由現金流利潤率為 22.4%，普通股權益報酬率達 141.5% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。

**二、Evercore ISI 目標價與評等**

Evercore ISI 討論了 Apple 的股票，將目標價從 330 美元調升至 365 美元，並維持「優於大盤」的評等。在其報告中，Evercore ISI 提到了 iPhone 的高溢價以及一款摺疊手機 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0]。

**三、市場綜合看法**

市場對 Apple 的評價呈現「高品質溢價與增長放緩」的雙刃劍觀點，可從以下幾個面向剖析：

1. **估值溢價與增長放緩的權衡**：Apple 的遠期本益比為 33.5 倍，價格與現金流量比為 30.7 倍，市場正在為其 Services 組合、資本回報和品牌護城河支付溢價。然而，其 12.8% 的年營收增長率以及 9.6% 的遠期營收增長率在硬體同業中相對較弱（例如低於 WDC 的 32.0%），這使得該估值溢價的合理性成為市場核心爭論點 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。

2. **現金流與資本回報的防護網**：Apple 的現金生成能力獨樹一格，TTM 自由現金流達 1,292 億美元，這足以輕鬆覆蓋 FY 2026 上半年執行的 77 億美元股息與 370 億美元股票回購 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。此外，Apple 在 2025 年 5 月宣布了額外高達 1,000 億美元的股票回購計畫 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]，為投資者提供了實質的回報底線。

3. **AI 與新產品的潛在催化劑**：市場關注 Apple 在 AI 領域的進展，包括推出 Siri AI 與 Apple Intelligence 平台應用於 Safari 等應用程式 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0]。RiverPark Large Growth Fund 指出，Apple 設備端 AI 功能的早期採用率超出內部預期，且 iPhone 17 的銷售趨勢優於預期，這些因素推動了股價上漲 [AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0]。

4. **下行風險**：Apple 在財報中警示，未來毛利率將面臨波動與下行壓力，且關稅成本已對 Products 毛利率造成部分抵銷 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。分析評論也指出，在遠期本益比超過 33 倍且遠期營收增長低於 10% 的情況下，若發生 iPhone 銷售失誤或關稅升級，將難以有容錯空間 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。

records.answer:
Amazon 近一年的營收成長率約為 **16.6%**（年增率，YoY），此為截至 2026 年 6 月 12 日所彙整的過去十二個月（TTM）數據 [AMZN_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0]。

從各業務板塊來看，Amazon 的成長動能呈現差異化表現。AWS（雲端服務）為三大板塊中增速最快，2025 年全年營收年增 20%，達 1,287.25 億美元，佔總營收比重從 2024 年的 17% 升至 2025 年的 18% [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #24]。相較之下，北美業務 2025 年營收為 4,263.05 億美元，年增 10%；國際業務營收為 1,618.94 億美元，年增 13% [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #24]。整體合併營收在 2025 年達 7,169.24 億美元，年增 12% [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #24]。

至於問題中提到「避險基金在 SpaceX IPO 前拋售包括 Amazon 在內的大型科技股」一事，提供的參考資料中並未包含任何與此相關的資訊。我無法在現有知識庫中找到支持該說法的依據，因此無法就此對市場如何看待 Amazon 做出分析。
